title: Come back to a language you know
description: Find the individual gaps after a break and start there, keeping access to the basic explanations.

blocks.text: After a few years without practice a person remembers more than a beginner course assumes. Compulsory lessons on greetings hold the return up, but jumping automatically to a high level can also miss an important gap.

quote.text: Just came back after a several year hiatus. And see despite what appears to be a complete revamp of the app nobody thought adding a placement test was worthwhile?

blocks.text: Find the point to come back to

Instead of a single final score there are short tries: catch a phrase by ear, read a text, answer, change the form of a word. The person picks a difficulty to review and can open the matching explanation right away.

What to test is a return to one language after a real break. If a short diagnostic only changes the lesson number, there is no separate product in it. The use comes from a convenient route through individual skills and the right to skip what is already familiar.
